summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned exclusively by maintain-knowledge-base with explicit append-only maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, single existing target plan, pinned main commit, timestamp, non-automatic flag, authority, and hash-verified stale-maintenance route; publish gate fails closed without bindings; Acceptance stale-catalog route is typed, hash-bound, persisted, and non-authorizing; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; global catalogs index stable semantic plan sources only, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive freshness loops; standalone builder read-only, formal activation requires validated capability; versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/registry files select highest numeric version and support both ledger naming variants; historical/read-only checks remain compatible, new publications record summary/hash; extends ADR-0044, ADR-0048, ADR-0050; no supersession
